consumable.name: Vigor Tonic
consumable.desc: Permanently raises a curio's ^health^. Works best on [earth] and [physical] curios.

consumable.name: Power Draught
consumable.desc: Permanently raises a curio's ^damage^. Works best on [fire] and [dark] curios.

consumable.name: Mender's Salve
consumable.desc: Permanently raises a curio's ^healing^. Works best on [light] and [water] curios.

consumable.name: Lucky Coin
consumable.desc: Permanently raises a curio's ^luck^, which decides how often it lands a critical hit.

consumable.name: Focus Crystal
consumable.desc: Permanently raises a curio's ^mana^, so it can cast its heavier skills sooner.

consumable.name: Greater Vigor Tonic
consumable.desc: A far stronger ^health^ tonic. Works best on [earth] and [physical] curios.

consumable.name: Greater Power Draught
consumable.desc: A far stronger ^damage^ draught. Works best on [fire] and [dark] curios.

consumable.name: Greater Mender's Salve
consumable.desc: A far stronger ^healing^ salve. Works best on [light] and [water] curios.

consumable.name: Hero's Elixir
consumable.desc: Raises ^health^ and ^damage^ at once. Any curio can drink it.

consumable.name: Prismatic Essence
consumable.desc: Raises every stat of one curio. The rarest enhancement there is.
